NISSAN LEAF® FAQs
Does the Nissan LEAF use gasoline? Can I drive LEAF on the freeway?
No, never. LEAF runs off of 100% electric battery power, no gas needed. In fact, it Of course! With instant torque and speeds up to 90 mph, LEAF is freeway-ready.
doesn’t even have a tailpipe. Even better, LEAF qualifies for a single-occupancy HOV sticker in select states,
so you can use the carpool lane any time you want.1
Will the price include the battery pack? Or will there be an option to
rent/lease the battery pack? What happens if I run out of battery?
The total cost of the vehicle includes the battery pack. Both lease and purchase LEAF comes with helpful tools that keep you aware of your battery level at all
options are available for the vehicle, but no option to rent/lease just the battery pack. times. However, for added peace of mind, every LEAF comes with three years of
complimentary roadside assistance.4
Can I charge if I’m not at home?
Yes. Across the country you’ll find a public infrastructure of charging stations. Visit Does the battery come with a warranty?
http://nissan.chargepointportal.net/external/nissanmap/ to find a station near you.9 Yes, LEAF’s advanced battery comes with an 8-year/100,000-mile warranty.7
Will there be more public charging stations in the future? Does LEAF have the same safety features as a conventional car?
The public charging network is expanding every day, with 15,000 stations Yes. LEAF comes with a comprehensive list of safety equipment, including six
expected to be in place by 2014. Nissan is also beginning to roll out DC standard air bags14 and advanced safety features like Vehicle Dynamic Control
quick-charging stations. These charge stations will be capable of giving you (VDC)16 and Traction Control System (TCS).
an 80% charge in just 30 minutes.9
Am I required to buy the home charging station when I
purchase LEAF?
No. However, the home charging dock is recommended.
visit NissanUSA.com/leaf
How long will it take to charge my LEAF at home?
With the 240-volt home charging dock, your MY13 LEAF will be fully charged in And follow Nissan on:
about 4 hours (SV and SL trims, available S trim) or 7 hours (S trim).5
Will charging my LEAF increase my electricity bill?
The average driver should only see a moderate bump in their monthly electricity bill
– and if you charge during off-peak hours, even less – though the savings in gas
money should more than make up for it.
